builds.name: Concussive Blows: stun and follow-up magic window
builds.summary: Investigate high one Concussive Blows stun and four-second follow-up window output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Concussive Blows stun and four-second follow-up window output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The level table gives 186 magic on a level-18 four-stack detonation, with follow-up Braum attacks dealing 40% of that base during the same-target stack immunity period. Neither helper has an AD or AP coefficient. Attack frequency, magic penetration and eligible amplification are the experiment; AP alone does not grow the core flat damage.

ceiling.targetName: one Concussive Blows stun and four-second follow-up window
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Three real Concussive Blows stacks already valid on the scored champion; one fourth attack starts the measured stun event. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped, Exactly six earned Lethal Tempo stacks, four earned Rageblade stacks and ten earned Legend: Alacrity stacks. Prepare the attack stacks through real attacks across two victims while leaving the scored victim at three valid passive stacks; record current AS and stack timers. Lethal Tempo and item damage are excluded from the passive-only total. Count subsequent actual Braum attacks during the four-second immunity window, excluding a boundary hit after immunity ends. Record actual start HP after preparation; no ally attacks.
